```{r}
# ============================================================
# Prepare standalone OncodriveFML input from pILC WES MAF
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
})

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Paths
# ------------------------------------------------------------

base_dir <- paste0(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/",
  "PCGR/Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON"
)

maf_file <- file.path(
  base_dir,
  "maftools/Tier_1_common/Combined_MAF/",
  "Tier_1_common_all_samples.combined.maf"
)

fml_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "OncodriveFML")
input_dir <- file.path(fml_dir, "input")
results_dir <- file.path(fml_dir, "results")
logs_dir <- file.path(fml_dir, "logs")
config_dir <- file.path(fml_dir, "config")

dir.create(input_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(logs_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(config_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

stopifnot(file.exists(maf_file))

message("Input MAF: ", maf_file)
message("OncodriveFML directory: ", fml_dir)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Read MAF
# ------------------------------------------------------------

maf <- fread(
  maf_file,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  skip = "Hugo_Symbol",
  data.table = TRUE,
  showProgress = TRUE
)

message("Total MAF rows: ", nrow(maf))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Check required columns
# ------------------------------------------------------------

required_cols <- c(
  "Tumor_Sample_Barcode",
  "Chromosome",
  "Start_Position",
  "Reference_Allele",
  "Tumor_Seq_Allele2",
  "Variant_Classification"
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(maf))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required MAF columns: ",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Keep coding variants
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# OncodriveFML will independently determine functional impact
# using its score database. Silent variants may therefore be
# retained because they contribute to the observed mutation set.

coding_classes <- c(
  "Silent",
  "Missense_Mutation",
  "Nonsense_Mutation",
  "Nonstop_Mutation",
  "Splice_Site",
  "Splice_Region",
  "Translation_Start_Site",
  "Frame_Shift_Del",
  "Frame_Shift_Ins",
  "In_Frame_Del",
  "In_Frame_Ins"
)

maf_coding <- maf[
  Variant_Classification %in% coding_classes
]

message(
  "Rows after coding classification filter: ",
  nrow(maf_coding)
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare OncodriveFML five-column input
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fml_input <- maf_coding[
  ,
  .(
    CHROMOSOME = as.character(Chromosome),
    POSITION   = as.integer(Start_Position),
    REF        = toupper(as.character(Reference_Allele)),
    ALT        = toupper(as.character(Tumor_Seq_Allele2)),
    SAMPLE     = as.character(Tumor_Sample_Barcode)
  )
]

# Remove chr prefix
fml_input[
  ,
  CHROMOSOME := gsub(
    "^chr",
    "",
    CHROMOSOME,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )
]

# Standard chromosomes only
fml_input <- fml_input[
  CHROMOSOME %in% c(as.character(1:22), "X", "Y")
]

# Remove incomplete records
fml_input <- fml_input[
  !is.na(CHROMOSOME) &
  !is.na(POSITION) &
  !is.na(REF) &
  !is.na(ALT) &
  !is.na(SAMPLE) &
  CHROMOSOME != "" &
  POSITION > 0 &
  REF != "" &
  ALT != "" &
  SAMPLE != "" &
  REF != "." &
  ALT != "."
]

# Remove REF == ALT
fml_input <- fml_input[REF != ALT]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Convert MAF indel representation
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# OncodriveFML represents:
# insertion: REF = "-", ALT = inserted sequence
# deletion:  REF = deleted sequence, ALT = "-"

fml_input[
  REF %in% c("", "."),
  REF := "-"
]

fml_input[
  ALT %in% c("", "."),
  ALT := "-"
]

# Remove unsupported symbolic alleles
valid_allele <- function(x) {
  grepl("^([ACGT]+|-)$", x)
}

fml_input <- fml_input[
  valid_allele(REF) & valid_allele(ALT)
]

# Remove duplicated mutation records
fml_input <- unique(fml_input)

message("Final OncodriveFML input rows: ", nrow(fml_input))
message("Number of samples: ", uniqueN(fml_input$SAMPLE))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Save input
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fml_input_file <- file.path(
  input_dir,
  "pILC_WES_oncodrivefml_input.tsv"
)

fwrite(
  fml_input,
  fml_input_file,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = "NA"
)

# Also create compressed input
system2(
  command = "gzip",
  args = c(
    "-kf",
    shQuote(fml_input_file)
  )
)

message("Saved OncodriveFML input:")
message(fml_input_file)
message(paste0(fml_input_file, ".gz"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# QC: mutation burden per sample
# ------------------------------------------------------------

qc_sample_burden <- fml_input[
  ,
  .N,
  by = SAMPLE
][order(-N)]

setnames(qc_sample_burden, "N", "Mutation_count")

fwrite(
  qc_sample_burden,
  file.path(
    results_dir,
    "QC_mutation_count_per_sample_used_for_OncodriveFML.tsv"
  ),
  sep = "\t"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# QC: mutation type
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fml_input[
  ,
  Mutation_type := fifelse(
    nchar(REF) == 1 & nchar(ALT) == 1 &
      REF != "-" & ALT != "-",
    "SNV",
    fifelse(
      REF == "-",
      "Insertion",
      fifelse(
        ALT == "-",
        "Deletion",
        "MNV_or_complex"
      )
    )
  )
]

qc_mutation_type <- fml_input[
  ,
  .N,
  by = Mutation_type
][order(-N)]

setnames(qc_mutation_type, "N", "Mutation_count")

fwrite(
  qc_mutation_type,
  file.path(
    results_dir,
    "QC_variant_type_counts_used_for_OncodriveFML.tsv"
  ),
  sep = "\t"
)

print(qc_mutation_type)

message("OncodriveFML input preparation completed.")
```
